verdict.rationale: AMD markets the RX 9070 XT as enabling a 'private machine learning workstation' and a 'secure...alternative to relying solely on cloud-based solutions,' implying local processing keeps data off external servers, which indirectly prevents third-party model training on user data. However, there is no explicit privacy policy, opt-out mechanism, or data-training control statement — the claim is inferred from local-execution framing rather than a stated privacy guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit data-handling/training-opt-out policy, no independent confirmation that local ROCm workflows never phone home telemetry for AI training, no dedicated privacy documentation.
